**Finding submitted: deviation (critical, indemnity).**

- **Issue:** § 12(b) (p0073/p0075) is TrueLink's sole indemnity and reaches only claims "arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations." No IP infringement indemnity exists anywhere in the Agreement — the only infringement language (p0024, p0041, p0055) runs against Client. Meanwhile § 12(a) imposes a very broad Client indemnity (Client breach, Web Site/Client Content, product/service injury).
- **Why it fails the fallback:** the fallback minimum is a Vendor IP indemnity with usual exclusions/remedies; here there is none, which sits close to walk-away territory.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** new § 12(c) inserted after p0075 giving TrueLink a defend-and-indemnify obligation for (i) IP infringement/misappropriation by the Interface, Hosting/Support Services or deliverables, (ii) TrueLink's breach of law, (iii) unauthorized access to Client Content/Confidential Information caused by TrueLink, and (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, plus standard notice/control/cooperation procedure. Client's indemnity left untouched as the minimal edit, with an IP-only fallback offered in the comment.
